1.title: 概覽
content: 她是一位退役的職業電競選手，也是《鬥陣特攻》職業賽場上的常客。![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 是一位駕駛機甲的戰士（Tank），擅長在戰鬥中持續移動以尋找最佳位置。面對技術高超的 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 玩家，會感覺她彷彿同時出現在戰場的每個角落，無論你逃到哪裡，她總會現身並阻止你的行動。
她無法以傳統的方式擔任戰士（Tank）。如果你試圖讓她固守陣地並封鎖咽喉點，她的機甲很快就會被摧毀。在許多戰士（Tank）的對局中，她的目標是完全避開敵方的戰士（Tank），讓對方在戰場上無所事事。

對於 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 玩家來說，對局與地圖知識尤為重要，因為防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）可以完全抵銷敵方的技能，但前提是她必須處於正確的位置。隨時留意哪位隊友需要協助，並善用推進器（Boosters）與防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）的短冷卻時間，幫助他們創造關鍵的致勝機會。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 保持靈活應變。利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 的機動性來回應敵方隊伍的進攻位置與目標。

* 進行保護與支援。![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）應該用於確保後排生存，並在輸出英雄發動攻擊時提供保護。
* 先保護好自己。別忘了，如果你想對隊伍有所貢獻，就必須保持生存並維持機甲狀態。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 創造交叉火網。從多個方向攻擊 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va，能讓她無法利用防禦矩陣（Matrixing）吸收你們全隊的傷害。
* 保持團結。專注於互相支援以維持生存，並迫使她撤退。每當她離開近距離戰鬥範圍，她的價值就會大幅降低。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 對於光束與近戰攻擊毫無防禦能力。如果你感到棘手，請考慮更換英雄來進行反制。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 低冷卻時間
* 防禦
* 爆發傷害
* 極差的遠程傷害
* 方向性傷害減免
* 區域控制型絕招

3.1.1.title: 低冷卻時間的機動性
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/390fb173c801c718.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fboosters.png)Boosters have the lowest cooldown of any Tank movement ability in OW. On top of that, they allow her to fly in any direction. ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va can quickly engage and then disengage, fly to defend her team, or fly to help her team secure an elim.

3.1.2.title: 防禦矩陣
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）是基於資源而非生命值的機制，這代表她在技能持續期間可以吸收無限的傷害。她也是唯一能完全吸收像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/7578824db04164d2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fblizzard.png)暴雪（Blizzard）這類絕招的坦克。![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣的強大與多功能性，使 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 成為坦克中最強的隊伍輔助者。

3.1.3.title: 爆發傷害
content: 在近距離時，她同時使用散彈槍與 ![](/data/assets/guide/cb85107f12591c3b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmicro-missiles.png)微型飛彈（Micro Missiles）能造成極高的爆發傷害。當你的隊伍無法解決敵方的支援角色時，![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 可以化身為後排刺客切入，在敵方其餘成員反應過來之前擊殺其中一人。

3.2.1.title: 極差的遠程傷害
content: 只要 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 沒有貼在敵人臉上，她的傷害基本上都可以完全忽略。![](/data/assets/guide/cb85107f12591c3b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmicro-missiles.png)微型飛彈（Micro Missiles）緩慢的飛行速度也導致它們無法成為可靠的遠程傷害來源。

3.2.2.title: 方向性傷害減免
content: 雖然有些坦克可以阻擋來自多個方向或其前方大範圍的傷害，但 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 的 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）是一個位於她正前方的錐形區域。如果你在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）時瞄準不夠精確，就會浪費資源，甚至無法吸收你原本想抵擋的傷害。這也使得她在開闊地帶容易因為交叉火網而陷入苦戰。

3.2.3.title: 區域控制型絕招
content: 在最低階的牌位中，你或許能靠著將 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 的炸彈射向空中，並隨機造成敵方隊伍全滅來獲勝。然而，一旦你開始爬分，就會很快發現玩家們已經很擅長在 ![](/data/assets/guide/182487a51a584671.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fself-destruct.png)自爆（Self-Destruct）飛過空中時找到掩體躲避。

在高階場中，此絕招的最佳用途通常是作為區域控制工具。僅僅是強迫敵人走避幾秒鐘，其影響力遠不如使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)地裂擊（Earthshatter）或重力噴湧（Grav）來暈眩整個隊伍來得巨大。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：核融合砲
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/2a1e12556e664cb2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffusion-cannons.png)核融合砲的使用技巧
* 利用最近的掩體
* 由於射程有限，你應該隨時尋求盡可能靠近敵人的位置。
* 在掩體間移動，並嘗試佔據離敵人最近的掩體。你能安全推進得越遠，就越有機會找到合適的突襲目標。
* 無限彈藥
* 你的主要攻擊具有廣泛的彈道擴散與無限彈藥，非常適合持續造成小額傷害。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 是追擊使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/e02932bc2fe16c69.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranslocator.png)傳送器 的 ![](/data/assets/guide/670bb2169385300d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsombra.png)駭影 的最佳人選，因為你的散彈槍可以揭露 ![](/data/assets/guide/670bb2169385300d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsombra.png)駭影 的隱形位置。
* 此外，每一點傷害都會重置自我治療的被動技能。當敵人生命值偏低且沒有醫護兵（Medic）能為其治療時，請務必善加利用這一點。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：防禦矩陣
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣的使用技巧
* 學習對戰組合

* * 根據敵方隊伍的英雄選擇，你對![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣的使用重點會有所改變。如果對方有![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)莫伊拉，你應該要吃掉她所有的![](/data/assets/guide/b4447c9cc5302954.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-orb.png)生化球。如果對方有![](/data/assets/guide/2b23a0f925f80146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunkrat.png)炸彈鼠，請用![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣來抵銷他的震盪地雷、![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特的![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊、![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧、![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜的生化手榴彈，以此類推。
* 所有可以被防禦矩陣吸收的高價值技能，都應該成為你的主要目標。
* 掩護隊友

* * 推進器與![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣是所有戰士中掩護隊友的最佳技能組合。舉例來說，當你看到![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)攔路豬勾住隊友時，請使用![](/data/assets/guide/390fb173c801c718.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fboosters.png)推進器並開啟![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣來抵擋後續傷害，讓隊友得以存活。
* 輔助隊友

* * 你的輸出型英雄是否正在進行高風險、高回報的行動？對他們施放![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣，能大幅降低風險並提高他們成功的機率。

* 與你的輸出型英雄配合，並在他們使用絕招時保護他們。![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)法拉的![](/data/assets/guide/bdc23f8912816520.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrage.png)彈幕飛彈、![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)卡西迪的![](/data/assets/guide/4c3fdbb733566161.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeadeye.png)彈無虛發，以及![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神的![](/data/assets/guide/ffc140c6d6a32c46.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeath-blossom.png)死亡綻放，都是能從![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣保護中獲益良多的絕招範例。

4.3.title: [Shift]：推進器
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/390fb173c801c718.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fboosters.png)推進器的技巧
* 果斷行動

* ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 無法承受被動或是站在原地猶豫不決。她的短射程意味著她無法站在主戰場進行消耗，而防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）的短持續時間也讓她無法成為只會舉盾的機器人。
* 俯衝與交戰

* 如果你要使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/390fb173c801c718.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fboosters.png)推進器進行強勢進攻，請務必確保擁有充足的防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）能量，這樣你才能在反擊中存活下來。
* 永遠嘗試從戰鬥的外圍切入，絕對不要從中心點進攻。這樣你將更容易孤立敵人，同時也能承受較少的傷害。
* 脫離戰場
* 如果你深入敵陣或是在目標點被壓制，而敵方全隊突然集火你時，請使用推進器撤退到安全地帶。大約三秒後，你的生命值就會恢復，並準備好再次使用推進器重返戰場。

4.4.title: [E]：微型飛彈（Micro Missiles）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/cb85107f12591c3b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmicro-missiles.png)微型飛彈（Micro Missiles）的使用技巧
* 不要用飛彈進行騷擾
* 很容易陷入遠距離使用飛彈射擊敵方屏障的陷阱。這會極大浪費飛彈，並讓敵人有機會推進，因為他們知道你無法瞬間爆發擊殺他們。
* 最佳爆發傷害

* 使用推進器（Booster），等待直到靠近目標，然後施放 ![](/data/assets/guide/cb85107f12591c3b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmicro-missiles.png)微型飛彈（Micro Missiles）並配合散彈槍，以瞬間爆發傷害擊殺敵人。這對於處理位於側翼或非主流位置的敵人極為有效。

* 對抗像 ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)法拉、![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)慈悲和 ![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)迴音這類空中敵人時，請務必等待他們用掉主要位移技能，隨後使用推進器（Booster）追擊，讓他們無法逃脫。
* 防禦矩陣（Matrix）與飛彈

* 當你需要壓制敵方輸出時，同時保護自己並進行攻擊非常實用。直接貼近敵人並開啟防禦矩陣（Matrix）可以阻擋所有投射物傷害與投射物治療。此外，你的 ![](/data/assets/guide/cb85107f12591c3b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmicro-missiles.png)微型飛彈（Micro Missiles）也能持續對他們造成傷害。只要有一名隊友與你配合進攻，敵人通常必死無疑。

4.5.title: 絕招：自爆
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/182487a51a584671.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fself-destruct.png)自爆的使用技巧
* 推進炸彈
* 99% 的情況下，你會希望將爆炸的機甲向前發射，而不是原地彈射。
* 推進器的剩餘資源量決定了機甲飛行的距離。
* 一個好用的經驗法則是：在使用絕招前先消耗 50% 的推進器資源，以確保機甲在爆炸前會落回地面。這樣可以避免你不小心飛過頭，錯過敵方隊伍。
* 第二條命

* 有時候使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/182487a51a584671.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fself-destruct.png)自爆是為了快速召喚機甲。如果你在絕招就緒的情況下機甲被摧毀，請毫不猶豫地使用你的絕招。

4.6.title: [Q]：呼叫機甲
content: 關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/068bc5e965810679.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcall-mech.png)呼叫機甲 的提示
* 保持安全
* 決定何時何地重新呼叫機甲時，最重要的考量是您是否能存活下來。在呼叫機甲前，請先躲到掩體後方。

* 此外，請記住 ![](/data/assets/guide/068bc5e965810679.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcall-mech.png)呼叫機甲 會被駭入、擊退和昏迷效果中斷。請留意擁有這些技能的敵方位置。
* 若距離極近，可秒殺 250 生命值的英雄。
* 通常不建議這樣做，但若是為了娛樂或特定情境，這招在關鍵時刻能發揮奇效。

4.7.title: 被動技能：彈射
content: 當機甲被摧毀時，你會從中彈射出來。
關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/3727e1ebb5a40942.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Feject.png)彈射！的技巧：
* 如果戰鬥已經無力回天，請確保快速陣亡，不要拖累隊伍節奏（stagger）。在駕駛員型態下，最糟糕的情況就是讓已經重生回來的隊友，還得等你遲遲無法重生。

4.8.title: 主要攻擊：光線槍
content: 關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/83cc24b57b713e82.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Flight-gun.png)光線槍的提示

* 當你身為駕駛員狀態的 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 時，請與敵人保持距離，並鎖定最容易擊中的目標，以快速獲得 ![](/data/assets/guide/068bc5e965810679.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcall-mech.png)呼叫機甲。
* 不要放棄；你嬌小的身軀讓敵人很難擊中你。有時你甚至能贏得 1 對 1 的對決並重新召喚機甲。

5.1.1.title: 兔兔之力
5.1.1.description: 彈射會賦予 75 點暫時性超量生命，且呼叫機甲的傷害半徑增加 50%。
content: * 安全次要特殊能力

* 額外的生命值讓她更容易存活到足以重新呼叫機甲。當 D.Va 從機甲彈射出來時，敵人總是想立刻擊殺駕駛員 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)。兔兔之力能幫助她承受這些攻擊。

5.1.2.title: 強化推進器（Extended Boosters）
5.1.2.description: 使用推進器（Boosters）擊中敵人會造成 40% 的額外傷害，並延長 0.5 秒的持續時間。
content: * 非常適合進行突擊
* * 當突擊敵方後排時，你可以透過推進器（Boosters）穿過敵方坦克以及路徑上的任何敵人，藉此觸發強化推進器（Extended Boosters）。

* 例如，當你擁有更長的飛行時間時，追擊 ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)慈悲（Mercy）會變得輕鬆許多。
* 數值
* * 每次擊退造成 25 點傷害。
* 基礎推進器（Boosters）的持續時間為 2 秒。擊中兩名敵人可延長 50% 的持續時間。

5.2.1.title: 護盾系統
5.2.1.description: 將 150 點生命值轉換為護盾。防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）會根據其吸收傷害量的 25% 來恢復護盾。
content: * 提升自我續航能力

* 護盾生命值會移至 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 生命值條的最前方，並會優先受到傷害。
* 防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）將吸收的傷害轉換為恢復失去的護盾生命值，能提升你在戰鬥中的生存能力。

5.2.2.title: 精準融合
5.2.2.description: 按下重新裝填，使融合加農砲的擴散範圍降低 75%，持續 3 秒。
content: * 當你想要專注於進攻能力與擊殺潛力時最為實用。
* 請保留此技能用於最後一擊，而非在攻擊開始時就使用。

6.title: 地圖
content: D.Va 相較於其他戰士最顯著的優勢，在於她能每 3.5 秒進行一次持續 2 秒的飛行 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)。她能從擁有廣闊高台區域的地圖中獲得最大效益。由於她的傷害僅在極短距離內有效，因此地形平坦且開闊的地圖對她來說並不理想。然而，這並不代表她適合待在目標點進行近身肉搏。空間狹窄的控制（Control）據點無法提供她足夠的移動空間，這會使她在正面對決的戰士對抗中處於劣勢。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: 最能發揮 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 機動性與傷害減免優勢的隊伍陣容為「側襲者（Dive）」與「遠程消耗（Poke）」陣容。![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 擅長透過快速且頻繁的重新走位來支援隊友。為了造成顯著的傷害，她必須貼近敵方臉上進行近距離戰鬥。正因如此，![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 常與那些能瞬間集火單一目標的側襲者英雄搭配使用。

作為防禦者與支援者，![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 能讓她的遠程與即時命中（Hitscan）隊友佔據更具侵略性的位置，同時透過自身的存在感與防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）來保護他們。

在對抗遠程消耗陣容時，她同樣表現出色，因為防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）是基於資源的技能，可以吸收無限的傷害。再加上她控制高地的能力，擁有 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 的遠程消耗陣容總是佔有優勢。
**以 D.Va 為核心的隊伍陣容範例：**

* **坦克**：![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va、![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特

* **輸出**：![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西、![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神

* **輔助**：![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)禪亞塔、![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜

7.1.title: 與其他英雄的個人搭配
content:
![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特 (6v6)
* 當與 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特搭配時，[[__OWH_IMG_2__]]D.Va 能彌補他所有的弱點。她可以處理高處的敵人，並在他放下護盾進行揮擊時為他施放防禦矩陣。當萊因哈特能衝鋒越過敵方坦克時，他們甚至可以一起進行突襲。
* 兩者同時也是遠程隊友絕佳的保護者，隊友可以站在他們的護盾與防禦矩陣後方，同時進行壓制性火力輸出。

![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)死神
* 當 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)死神進行側襲時，能有效分散敵人對 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 的注意力。她的推進器也讓 [[__OWH_IMG_3__]]D.Va 能迅速突襲任何被 [[__OWH_IMG_4__]]死神突襲的目標。擊殺 [[__OWH_IMG_5__]]死神最容易的時機，就是他被困在施放「死亡綻放（Death Blossom）」的旋轉過程中。由 [[__OWH_IMG_7__]]防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）掩護的死亡綻放具有驚人的殺傷力，且難以阻擋。

[[__OWH_IMG_1__]]禪亞塔
* 擁有這名玻璃大砲型支援角色的隊伍，在進攻時總能佔據上風。只要 [[__OWH_IMG_1__]]禪亞塔還活著，[[__OWH_IMG_2__]]D.Va 就能在 [[__OWH_IMG_3__]]禪亞塔受到集火時進行保護（Peel），協助他留在戰場上。他長距離的傷害輸出與 [[__OWH_IMG_4__]]紛亂之珠（Orb of Discord）也是協助 [[__OWH_IMG_5__]]D.Va 擊殺敵方後排的最佳支援工具。
![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper

* ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper helps to take attention away from ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va whenever he's on the flank. Her Boosters also allow ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va to quickly dive anyone ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper is surprise attacking. The easiest time to kill ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper is while he's stuck spinning in ![](/data/assets/guide/ffc140c6d6a32c46.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeath-blossom.png)Death Blossom. ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix covering Blossom is shockingly lethal and hard to stop.
![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta

* The team with this glass-cannon Support always has the upper hand on offense. Well, as long as ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta is alive, ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va can peel for ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta whenever he's getting focused and help him stay in the fight. His long-range damage and ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord are also the best Support tools to help ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va secure elims on the enemy backline.

8.title: 如何反制
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 最強的能力是她的 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）。使用不會被矩陣吸收的攻擊是直接反制她最簡單的方法。![](/data/assets/guide/1f8db820974b857f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fphoton-magnum.png)光子手槍（Photon Magnum）、![](/data/assets/guide/dfca9f5b755d9b41.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fphoton-projector.png)光子投射器（Photon Projector）、![](/data/assets/guide/319945fa8ef79cf6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-cannon.png)粒子砲（Particle Cannon）皆屬於光束武器，因此可以直接穿透矩陣。所有近戰攻擊，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)火箭槌（Rocket Hammer）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)龍一文字（Dragonblade）也同樣有效。
如果你的英雄只有投射物技能，你可以將自己定位在側邊或後方等矩陣無法吸收的角度進行射擊。

此外，任何能將她從 ![](/data/assets/guide/390fb173c801c718.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fboosters.png)推進器（Boosters）狀態中擊暈的能力都能中斷她的移動，這是讓她解除機甲的最佳方式。![](/data/assets/guide/61a533467bf9f01d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbinding-chain.png)束縛鎖鏈（Binding Chain）、![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/b87166103290a2c3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Faccretion.png)質量吸積（Accretion）都是強力的控場工具，你應該保留這些技能，直到她試圖飛走時再使用。
